text:
maria: Heads up, I opened a small TF change to add a secondary GPU subnet for burst pools. Nonblocking, no migration. Can someone take a quick look? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 I ran `terraform fmt` and the plan locally — shows only a subnet + route table association.

raj: quick q — which AZ is this for? any changes to NAT/GW or route propagation?

maria: same AZs as the existing GPU pool (us-west-2b), reusing existing NAT gateways. No route-prop changes expected. snippet from plan: 
```
# aws_subnet.gpu_secondary will be created
+ resource "aws_subnet" "gpu_secondary" {
    + cidr_block = "10.20.96.0/24"
    + availability_zone = "us-west-2b"
    + tags = {"k8s.io/cluster" = "redwood-prod", "role" = "gpu-burst-secondary"}
  }
# aws_route_table_association.gpu_secondary_assoc will be created
```

kevin: can you paste the route table diff? prefer to know exactly which RT it's associating to. also suggest merging in a low-traffic window — maybe 23:00 PST tonight? @oncall fyi.

ops-bot: CI: terraform plan check passed — https://ci.redwood-inference/dev/infra/482 (plan.md attached) :white_check_mark:

sarah: LGTM. tiny nit: add a `Name` tag that follows our convention, e.g. `gpu-burst-secondary-usw2b` so it's easy to find in console.

maria: good call, added the Name tag, updated PR description. I'll hold for one more approver and then merge during the 23:00 PST canary window unless anyone objects.

raj: :thumbsup:

kevin: looks good to me, approving now.

maria: thanks all — merging tonight unless something else comes up :tada:
